supports.name: Chunked text
supports.description: Cover all but 2 to 3 words so the learner reads a small group at a time.
supports.how_to_try: Use a card to show 2 to 3 words. Move it along as the learner reads.
supports.how_to_evaluate: Compare words read as written on the next matched passage.

supports.name: Sound-by-sound pointing
supports.description: The adult points under each sound while the learner says it, then blends the word.
supports.how_to_try: Point slowly under each letter group. Ask the learner to say each sound, then the whole word.
supports.how_to_evaluate: Note vowel-sound errors on the follow-up Trace.

supports.name: Reading ruler
supports.description: A plain card under the line being read keeps the place on the page.
supports.how_to_try: Place a blank card just under the line. Move it down line by line.
supports.how_to_evaluate: Note skipped lines or repeated lines on the next attempt.

supports.name: Pre-teach vocabulary
supports.description: Talk through 3 to 4 passage words before reading, with a picture or example.
supports.how_to_try: Pick the hardest words. Say each, show what it means, use it in a sentence.
supports.how_to_evaluate: Check whether those words are read as written next time.

supports.name: Listen then read
supports.description: The adult reads the passage aloud first while the learner follows, then the learner reads it.
supports.how_to_try: Read at a steady pace, pointing at each word. Then the learner reads the same passage.
supports.how_to_evaluate: Compare accuracy on a matched follow-up passage.

supports.name: Shorter instructions
supports.description: Give one step at a time and check before adding the next.
supports.how_to_try: Say the first step only. Wait for it, then give the next step.
supports.how_to_evaluate: Note whether the learner starts without re-asking.

supports.name: Extra processing time
supports.description: Pause at least 5 seconds after a question before repeating or helping.
supports.how_to_try: Ask once. Count silently to five. Repeat once if needed.
supports.how_to_evaluate: Note answers given after the pause.

supports.name: Respond in a different format
supports.description: Let the learner point, say, or show the answer instead of writing it.
supports.how_to_try: Offer two ways to answer. Let the learner choose.
supports.how_to_evaluate: Note whether the barrier changes with the format.

supports.name: Tinted reading background
supports.description: Offer a pale background tint for the passage as a comfort preference.
supports.how_to_try: Let the learner pick none, pale blue, pale yellow, or pale green.
supports.how_to_evaluate: Ask which they prefer. Record the choice only; claim no effect.
